prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic minimalist fashion editorial portrait of one original approved adult woman seated at a glossy reflective table in a conceptual Ace of Spades composition.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with long straight light-brown hair, clear natural skin texture, soft neutral makeup, calm serious direct gaze and quiet authority. She wears a tailored brown blazer, beige button-up shirt and matching brown tie for a refined androgynous look.
composition_elements: Vertical 4:5 symmetrical composition with subject seated upright and both hands placed near the center edge of a polished glass table.
Near-perfect reflection creates a dual-image playing-card effect.
Off-white background with supplied large black A and spade symbols in opposite corners; preserve supplied typography and symbols exactly.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused studio lighting with even illumination, minimal shadows, subtle highlights on hair and tailoring, warm vintage color treatment and gentle film grain.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 portrait, 85mm lens at f/4, controlled depth of field on subject and reflection, realistic fabric, skin and glass detail, no added text or watermark.
